facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2004-0020 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 7 February 2004 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The engineering change note record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the key safeguard named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state closed in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the key safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
